title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Cardholder Courtesy on Installation Reschedule Fees
content:
A Ridgeline Installation Services customer who holds a Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card in the Premier or Preferred tier, with a clean late-fee record, pays a reduced cardholder share of the customer reschedule fee.

## Cardholder share

| The customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit position | Cardholder share |
|---|---|
| holds an active Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier account and has no late fee assessed on any of their Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts less than 12 whole months before today | 0.5, the Premier cardholder share |
| holds an active Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred account and has no such late fee in that period | 0.75, the Preferred cardholder share |
| every other customer | 1 |

The customer reschedule fee is multiplied by the cardholder share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the customer reschedule fee is rounded, the customer reschedule fee being rounded to the cent only at the end. A customer who meets the Premier condition and the Preferred condition at once takes the Premier share of 0.5.

## Records that decide the share

- The customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts: the tier of each account (Classic, Preferred, Premier, or a Ridgeline Project Loan) and its status. Only an account whose status is active counts; a Premier or Preferred account that is suspended or closed does not.
- The fee lines on those accounts: every late fee assessed and the date it was assessed. A late fee on any of the customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit accounts, card or Project Loan, counts.

## Condition table

| Active Premier account | Active Preferred account | Late fee less than 12 whole months before today | Cardholder share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | no | 0.5 |
| no | yes | no | 0.75 |
| yes or no | yes or no | yes | 1 |
| no | no | no | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of 150.00 before the share)

| Customer (hypothetical) | Share | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| active Premier card, last late fee 14 months ago | 0.5 | 75.00 |
| active Preferred card, no late fee ever | 0.75 | 112.50 |
| active Premier card, late fee on a Project Loan 3 months ago | 1 | 150.00 |
| Classic card only | 1 | 150.00 |
